intro: Wrestling, judo and football are popular, along with the horse game buzkashi.

chapters.title: Athletes
text: Hammer thrower Dilshod Nazarov won Tajikistan's first Olympic gold in 2016. The football team reached the quarter-finals of its first Asian Cup in 2023.

chapters.title: Buzkashi
text: In buzkashi, riders fight to carry a goat carcass to a goal, often at Nowruz.

keyTerms.meaning: A horseback game played across Central Asia.

items.title: Tajikistan Higher League
items.subtitle: Football
items.text: Istiklol have won the most titles.

places.intro: Where Tajikistan's biggest sporting moments happen.
